sqlquery.from:
( select sts.name, pj.id,pj.name projectname, account.name client ,coalesce(t.taskCount,0) taskCount ,coalesce(notComplatedTaskCount,0) notComplatedTaskCount ,coalesce(tsh.timeSpentByProject,0) timeSpentByProject, coalesce(pj.percent,0) complete , coalesce(man.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(man.lastname) managername ,case when sts.code ='ONGOING' then 1 when isSystemReference is false then 2 when sts.code ='PS_NOT_STARTED' then 3 when sts.code ='PS_COMPLETED' then 4 end sorder
from "$".project pj left join "$".crmaccount account on pj.clientid = account.id left join "$".myuser man on pj.managerid=man.id left join (select count(t.id) taskCount,projectid ,count(case when r.code not in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED','CANCELLED') then 1 end ) notComplatedTaskCount from "$".task t left join "$".reference r on t.statusid=r.id where t.isIssue is not true and t.deleted is not true group by projectid) t on pj.id=t.projectid left join (select projectID, sum(timespent) timeSpentByProject from "$".timesheet group by projectID) tsh on pj.id=tsh.projectID join "$".reference sts on pj.statusid=sts.id
left outer join "$".projectemployee pe on pj.id=pe.projectid left outer join "$".teamemployee te on (pe.employeedepartmentid=te.id ) left outer join "$".myuser mu on (te.employeeid=mu.id)
where pe.isdeleted is not true and pj.isdeleted is not true and pj.parnetId is null and mu.id=#?user_id?# order by sorder asc, timeSpentByProject desc
)t
